purpose_context: Felix's inbox-capture agent intermittently hallucinates that its helper scripts do not exist and emits false 'system broken' alarms, because it runs on a weak model (haiku) that leaks into deterministic plumbing. This mission moves capture to a sonnet-class model and hardens the prompt so the model only does comprehension, routing, and interaction, restoring reliable capture without sacrificing Felix's interactivity.
purpose_tldr: Make Felix's inbox capture reliable by moving it to a stronger model and keeping the LLM out of the plumbing.
